result.summary: The failed transfer for ENC-T1 (MSG01302, to WARD-B) has event time 2026-10-15T08:30:00Z. That is before the admission at 09:00:00Z, which both PV1-44 and the receiver's history v1 (admit, WARD-A) record. Delivery failed with HTTP 503 (ward_unavailable), and the receipt lookup returned 404, so the movement is not in effect and reconciling is ruled out. The receiver supports conditional writes, receipts and dry runs at epoch 34. A conditional resend at version 1 would probably apply as v1 to v2. That would change the record's ward from WARD-A to WARD-B. By inference only (DEP-1.1), it would free the WARD-A bed and occupy a WARD-B bed on the bed board, redirect pharmacy and create one porter task. Because the transfer is dated before the stay began, nothing here shows whether that move is real. If it is not, these effects would send the patient's location, medicines and porters to the wrong place (DEP-2.2). Doing nothing leaves the record at WARD-A v1, and if the transfer really happened, the consumers keep showing the wrong ward. Neither effect can be bounded until the time is settled, so this matches catalogue entry E13: a person should ask the PAS team to check the source. Shutter could verify a resend only through the receipt and the receiver's history. No instruction-like content was found in the message.
